poses.name: sit
poses.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent chibi desktop companion, seated-on-UI-edge REST pose. Edit target/reference: the attached local standard standing illustration of our original pink-haired puppy girl. Change ONLY the pose and expression; preserve the SAME face, 2.5-head proportions, pink long curled hair, bent ahoge, teal eyes, square hair clip, soft floppy cocoa-brown dog ears with cream inner tips, cocoa tail with cream tip, cherry/black/ivory/gold dress, teal brooches, fingerless gloves and short lace-up boots. Do not give cat ears.

Draw her SITTING on an INVISIBLE narrow horizontal ledge, front view with a gentle small three-quarter turn, full body. Her skirt-covered bottom and both relaxed supporting palms rest on the SAME clean horizontal support line about 66% down the square canvas. Knees bend forward and BOTH lower legs dangle down below that line, small boots fully visible. One hand may gently prop her cheek, other hand flat on ledge near hip, relaxed tilted head, cozy half-lidded teal eyes and small contented smile. Body weight clearly settled on hips, cute sleepy puppy companionship, NOT standing/squatting/floating. Flowing hair and fluffy matching brown-cream tail curl behind to the left; all details fully inside canvas. No visible chair, cushion, ledge, floor, prop, shadow, background, UI, text or logo. The support itself must be genuinely transparent so runtime can align hips/palm to a real UI border. Do NOT draw any fake ledge or white strip.

Polished dimensional anime illustration, same delicate linework/materials and sharp detail as reference, not a new style. Square composition, character occupies ~88% of available width and 88% height with comfortable safety margin, front-on orthographic view. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside character. No redesign, extra limbs, extra fingers, scene or cropped hair/ears/boots.

poses.name: lie-initial
poses.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent production chibi desktop companion, horizontal tummy-down rest pose for reclining ON TOP OF a real chat input box.
Input image is our original character's identity/costume reference, NOT the pose to retain. Preserve the SAME pink-haired puppy girl, teal eyes, square hair clip, bent ahoge, soft FLOPPY cocoa-brown and cream dog ears, matching cocoa-brown fluffy tail with cream tip, black/cherry/ivory/gold ornate dress and teal brooches, gloved hands and short lace-up boots. Same polished dimensional anime linework and 2.5-head chibi proportions.

Change to a fully clothed adorable puppy-like LYING ON HER TUMMY pose, body extends horizontally from head at viewer-left to hips and boots at viewer-right. THREE-QUARTER FRONT view so her face looks toward us. Both forearms are folded horizontally under her chin; her cheek rests softly on the hands, peaceful half-lidded teal eyes, tiny warm contented smile. Her tummy and skirt-covered hips rest on the SAME invisible horizontal support level as the underside of her folded forearms. Legs extend behind, knees bent a little with small boots lifted slightly in a relaxed way, all limbs anatomically clear, skirt fully covers body. Long curled pink hair spreads softly behind/around shoulders without hiding the forearm support. Dog ears relaxed downward, fluffy brown tail with cream tip curves upward behind at right. Drowsy comfortable expression, cozy companion waiting while the user types.
Landscape canvas about 3:2. Character fills 90% of width and most height, with head, ears, ahoge, hands, boots and tail all fully visible. Flat horizontal implied contact line near lower quarter of frame for underside of forearms, belly and clothed hips. Some pink hair may hang a little below that line.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha outside the complete character. NO visible desk, floor, bed, cushion, ledge, surface, chair, UI, frame, text, logo, contact shadow or background. We will place the cutout on a real interface border; do not paint any support. Do not stand or sit. Do not change the costume, hair/ear/tail colors, style or identity. No exposed torso, no extra fingers/limbs, no cat ears, no clipping.

Keep her exact pose, peaceful face, pink hair, cocoa-brown/cream dog ears AND matching cocoa-brown/cream tail, costume, folded arms, lifted boots and illustration style. Only correct FRAMING: zoom the entire character out modestly and complete the tiny hair curls at left and right that touch the canvas edges.
